description: hyperGrid: A Provenance-First Visualisation Platform for Synthetic Irish Electricity Demand (SYNTH_GRID_IE) is a software deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Brian O Regan (Tyndall National Institute). hyperGrid is a provenance-first web platform for exploring SYNTH_GRID_IE, a weather-driven, hourly synthetic dataset of Irish building and data-centre electricity demand covering 2022–2023. Coverage: national (IE); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
